title: Organizations for Cursor Enterprise
description: Enterprise customers can now manage multiple Cursor teams from one place, with different security, governance, budget, and feature controls for each. These capabilities are now generally available to all Enterprise customers.

title: Devin Desktop GA Release
description: Devin Desktop is now generally available, allowing developers to manage fleets of local and cloud agents from one surface. Users can plan, delegate, review, and ship code without leaving their editor.

title: Windsurf is now Devin Desktop
description: Windsurf has been rebranded to Devin Desktop, maintaining the IDE features users love while adding more capabilities. This represents a strategic consolidation under the Devin brand.

community_feedback.quote: What? Devin is still alive? Is the same devin from 2 years ago?

title: Auto-review Run Mode (v3.6)
description: New auto-review run mode that allows Cursor to work for longer with fewer approval prompts and safer execution. This improves the autonomous coding experience with better safety controls.

title: Shared Canvases and /loop Skill (v3.5)
description: Introduced Shared Canvases feature and the /loop skill for local long-running agents. Users can now ask Cursor to perform recurring tasks like 'check deploy status every 5 minutes' or 'work on this feature until tests pass.'

title: Cursor Automations Improvements (v3.5)
description: Cursor Automations is now available in the Agents Window with ability to configure automations with multiple attached repos or no repos at all. Enhanced workflow automation capabilities for development teams.

title: Cursor in Jira Integration
description: Cursor is now available as an integration in Jira. Requires Cursor admin access and Jira Commercial Cloud with Rovo enabled. This brings AI coding assistance directly into Jira workflows.
